title: DistributionSummary
description: Inline per-CID distribution payload, hydrated onto every EPR/content response. ~100 bytes/item; drives badge state and simple-tier tooltips. Source of truth: composed from rea_commitments + economic_events using the T03d action conventions (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted as a new entity.

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas currently observed for this CID.

replicaTarget.description: Target replica count derived from the CID's reach + policy.

replicaHealth.description: Health bucket: healthy = at/above target, at_risk = below target, critical = below floor.

projectorCount.description: Number of doorways currently projecting this CID.

reachClass.description: Reach band the content is authored at — drives target replica count.

diversityHint.description: Peer-diversity hint for the replica set.

thisFetchSource.description: Where the bytes for this fetch came from.

lastVerifiedSeconds.description: Seconds since the last custodian probe verified the replica.

myRole.description: Viewer's role for this CID, when known.

reciprocityHint.description: Net diff: positive = viewer hosts more than is hosted for them.
